required_fields.session_epoch: nonempty String, current validated authority session generation
required_fields.character_id: nonempty String, current stable local character
required_fields.outcome_id: nonempty String, accepted canonical finale participant receipt

required_fields.chapter_choices: Array[String], zero or one resolved canonical personal offer decision per biome, using meadows|water|cloudreach|stormwood:accepted|refused. Unanswered remains omitted; accepted does not imply creature still owned.
required_fields.durable_home_return: bool, canonical HomeKey permit accepted AFTER this outcome and grounded Hall arrival durably finalized
required_fields.home_return_receipt: nonempty String after durable HomeKey arrival; may be empty before arrival

regional_ending_context() -> Dictionary.prearrival: Journey context with accepted outcome guides Home Key; it cannot open farm dialogue or credits. Even Meadows residents must perform the post-finale key use. Host and guest must validate their own ending lineage.
regional_ending_context() -> Dictionary.reconnect: Reconstruct canonical accepted outcome and HomeKey arrival lineage from durable receipts. Reject stale session/world/character bindings; never trust client ending claims. Globally completed credits must remain true across hosts.

commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.intent_fields: kind='regional_ending_ack', version=1, stage='homecoming_seen'|'regional_credits_seen', world_instance_id, session_epoch, character_id, outcome_id, home_return_receipt, party_revision, party_signature, transaction_id
commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.validation: Host derives identity from peer binding and independently checks accepted finale participant outcome, durable post-outcome key arrival, actual grounded safe farm location, canonical live party revision/signature and prerequisite saved homecoming for credits. Reject client-supplied facts. Capture immutable request envelope through bool-save wait; recheck generation before ACK.
commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.mutation_scope: Only globally portable personal homecoming_seen or regional_credits_seen acknowledgement, plus the owner's required transaction receipt. No inventory, creatures, rewards, privileges, teleport or world pause.
commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.return: status='pending'|'rejected'|'committed'. Committed requires durable=true and echoes the FULL typed intent envelope only after durable owner bool-save success; bool alone is rejected. Failed save rolls back tentative acknowledgement. Replay validates new context then echoes current envelope against same globally stable transaction without new save/payout.
commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.crash_window: If committed save succeeds and ACK is lost, reconnect sees durable receipt and cannot reopen acknowledged credits. An interrupted/failed precommit presentation remains pending for next Grandpa greeting. Completion means Continue/Skip, not watching every line.
commit_regional_ending_ack(intent: Dicti.postcredits: Derive endgame access from personal regional_credits_seen and canonical world aftermath. Preserve grounded farm/Hall pose, remaining activities and NPC/world aftermath; no new private fake completed-world flag. F43/F44/F45 consume canonical flags, never erase them.

foundations_methods.regional_ending_ack_result(transaction_i: Returns pending/rejected or fully matching committed typed envelope, scoped to current bound peer/character request. F20 timeout is configurable 8 seconds. No optimistic success.

Resolve same reader for journal/HUD/map/beacon. Return normal realm feed for nonparticipant or completed personal credits; personalize homecoming/credits done bits from canonical context.
shared_callers.stormwood_handoff: Deliver ending_aftermath only from the canonical accepted finale outcome when personal ending context is synchronized; legacy waterward view/physical gate is not a required trigger. Existing owned adapter fails closed if context not ready.

f18.presentation: On first durable result: glow, low hum, dust, one line 'It stirred, but it is not ready yet.' Reload glow restored silently. No realm entry, quest, marker, cliffhanger or sequel prompt; use allowed before/after homecoming.
f18.homekey_lineage: F18 final accepted grounded Hall arrival and stable permit/outcome IDs feed Foundations; F18 presentation never asserts ending eligibility.

proof_gate: No MET from this contract or synthetic test doubles. ROOT alone runs frozen named Godot checks, actual solo/two-peer ending with disconnect/reload and safe completed-world continuation; independent reviewer then scores exact F20#0-#4 after F18/F19 prerequisites.
